required_assumptions: s is an unevaluated unary function.
p and q are distinct symbolic variables; p-q is a nonzero symbolic denominator.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0002 and G0003 are evaluations of the same unary function s at p and q. G0001 is a symmetric rational combination of those evaluations divided by p-q. A single latent master function F(z)=s(z) generates all three catalog members.
